title: The best time to visit my country

fn.en: Talk about your likes and dislikes, and write a short web post recommending when to visit a place.

useful: The best time to come is…

items.r: hot and wet — your shirt sticks to you
cold and wet — the walls feel it too
the snow of one night or one day

sub.en: Look at the sentences. What form follows love, enjoy, don’t mind and can’t stand?

items.q: I love ___ in the sea in winter.
items.why: like / love / enjoy / don’t mind / can’t stand are all followed by verb + -ing.

items.q: I’m not keen ___ swimming in the summer.
items.why: be keen ON something. It means “I don’t like it much” — softer than “I hate it”.
don’t mind = it’s OK, it doesn’t bother me. Not the same as “I like it”.

items.q: He enjoys ___ picnics in the desert.
It’s worth ___ in October if you can.
___ in the middle of August — everything is closed.
She ___ to the coast twice a year.
items.why: RECYCLED: Present Simple with a frequency phrase.

items.from: I swim in the sea. I love it.
items.a: I love swimming in the sea

items.from: She walks in the desert. She enjoys it.
items.a: She enjoys walking in the desert

items.from: The rain is OK for me.
Coming in May is a good idea.

acts.title: The best time to visit Kazakhstan
text: People always ask me when they should come. Here is the honest answer.

COME IN MAY OR SEPTEMBER. The temperature is mild, the sky is usually clear and the mountains are open. May is the greener month; September is the quieter one. I love walking in the hills in September, when the air is cool and the tourists have gone home.
AVOID JULY AND AUGUST IN THE CITY. It gets to forty degrees and the air is humid and uncomfortable. Everybody who can leave, leaves. If you must come then, go north or go up.

WINTER IS NOT THE PROBLEM PEOPLE THINK. Yes, it’s cold — but it’s a dry cold, not a damp one, and the first snowfall is genuinely beautiful. I don’t mind the winter at all. The one thing I can’t stand is the week in March when everything melts.
DON’T MISS the mountains above Almaty on any trip, at any time of year. And it’s worth planning around a festival if you can: Nauryz in March is the big one.
Come in September. Bring a jacket for the evening. You’ll be fine.

tts: Faisal from Dubai. Winter’s my favourite season. In summer, it’s too hot to enjoy outdoor activities. But in winter, the temperature is really mild and pleasant — perfect for walks and picnics in the desert or in the city’s beautiful parks.

Also, the sea’s wonderful in the winter. I’m not keen on swimming in the sea in the summer. The water’s too warm and there are sea snakes and other nasty animals. In winter, it’s safer and fresher. My favourite winter activity is fishing.

write.q: Write your own web post: “The best time to visit my country”. Follow the six parts of the model — the question, when to come, when to stay away, the thing people get wrong, the thing not to miss, and one short final recommendation. Use at least three of the model’s phrases: It’s worth… / Avoid… / Don’t miss… / I don’t mind… / I can’t stand…
write.model: People always ask me when they should come. Here is the honest answer. COME IN LATE APRIL OR SEPTEMBER — the weather is mild and everything is open. AVOID THE MIDDLE OF JULY: it’s humid and the city empties. WINTER IS NOT THE PROBLEM PEOPLE THINK — I don’t mind it at all, and the first snowfall is beautiful. The one thing I can’t stand is the damp week in March. DON’T MISS the mountains, and it’s worth planning around Nauryz if you can. Come in September. Bring a jacket.

speak.q: Say your recommendation out loud in four sentences: when to come, when to stay away, one thing not to miss, and one thing you can’t stand about the other seasons.
speak.model: The best time to come is September — it’s mild and quiet. Avoid July, because it’s humid and everybody leaves. Don’t miss the mountains above the city. I can’t stand the week in March when everything melts.
